text: Threading cars between the ancient Baku city walls for a decade 🤩 ✨ @formula1 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP

🇫🇷 Isack Hadjar is set to make his return to Formula 1 this weekend at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku. After missing the Dutch, Italian and Spanish Grands Prix with a wrist injury, the Red Bull driver has completed his recovery and will be back alongside Max Verstappen. “Oracle Red Bull Racing is delighted to welcome Isack back this weekend,” the team confirmed. “Having made a successful recovery from his wrist injury, Isack will return to action at the Baku City Circuit on Thursday.” Liam Lawson, who stepped in for Hadjar over the past three rounds, will return to Racing Bulls, while Yuki Tsunoda resumes his reserve duties. #AzerbaijanGP26 @charlesleclerc
